implemented_requirements.evidence: board.py defines ROW_COUNT = 6, COLUMN_COUNT = 7 and Board.__init__ creates a grid of that size.
game.py stores players in a tuple and uses turn_index with next_turn() to alternate.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Players choose columns by typing a number
implemented_requirements.evidence: player.py::get_move prompts via ui.safe_input and parses the input as an integer column number.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Validate column choices (range and not full)
implemented_requirements.evidence: board.py::is_valid_column checks bounds and that the top cell is empty; player.py::get_move loops until a valid column is entered.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Drop disc to the lowest empty cell
implemented_requirements.evidence: board.py::drop_disc uses get_next_open_row to find the lowest empty row and places the disc there.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Detect horizontal, vertical, and diagonal four‑in‑a‑row
implemented_requirements.evidence: board.py::find_winning_line iterates over DIRECTIONS ((0,1),(1,0),(1,1),(-1,1)) and returns a line of four matching discs.

implemented_requirements.requirement: End the game when a winning line is detected
implemented_requirements.evidence: game.py::play checks board.find_winning_line after each move, sets self.winner and breaks the loop.

implemented_requirements.requirement: End the game when the grid is full (draw)
implemented_requirements.evidence: board.py::is_full returns True when the top row has no EMPTY cells; game.py::play breaks with a draw message when this is true.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Render the board after each move
implemented_requirements.evidence: ui.print_board calls board.render; game.py::play calls ui.print_board after every move and also after a win (with highlight).
